features.title: Update only what changed
features.description: The signed updater checks launcher, editor and scenery separately. It downloads only changed editor files and scenery models, and shows the changed piece names and estimated download size.

features.title: Keep installed scenery
features.description: Matching scenery files are reused and verified. Existing combined scenery packs are split locally during the first migration, avoiding a full scenery download when their model files match.

features.title: Separate release paths
features.description: Launcher, editor and scenery releases can be published independently, so an editor change does not rebuild or re-sign unchanged scenery.
